profile.reasoning: Valeria Haruna is a first-time founder, a recent graduate of the Vector Institute’s AI Engineering program, and fiercely proud of her Ukrainian heritage. She’s building ‘Synapse Solutions,’ a B2B SaaS platform leveraging generative AI to automate content localization for rapidly expanding tech companies. She noticed the pain point firsthand while working on international marketing campaigns at Shopify. She’s incredibly technically capable but less experienced in the fundraising world and can sometimes be overly focused on technical details when pitching. She’s aiming for a pre-seed round of $750k to scale her engineering team and expand beyond initial pilot customers. She’s very active in the Toronto tech community and values authentic connections. A key differentiator for Synapse is its focus on *nuance* in translation – going beyond literal accuracy to preserve brand voice and cultural context.
profile.positioning: Synapse Solutions is revolutionizing content localization for the global tech market. We provide a generative AI-powered SaaS platform that automates the translation and adaptation of marketing, sales, and product content, enabling companies to rapidly scale into new international markets. Unlike traditional translation services or basic machine translation tools, Synapse leverages advanced Large Language Models fine-tuned on industry-specific terminology and cultural nuances to deliver highly accurate and brand-consistent localized content. We are initially targeting Series A/B stage tech companies with aggressive international expansion plans. Our pilot program with three key clients has demonstrated a 60% reduction in localization costs and a 40% faster time-to-market for localized campaigns. We are currently achieving $15k MRR and project $100k MRR within the next six months.  We are building the future of global communication, one localized message at a time.
